title: I use this to dispense hand soap and it does that well but these are identical cheap plastic bottles
text:
I use this to dispense hand soap and it does that well but these are identical cheap plastic bottles. I have been wanting some tall skinny soap dispensers that fit between my faucet handles in the bathroom. These are perfect for that. I use both of them for hand soap and not shampoo or cream rinse.

The bottles are a very cheap white plastic with a metallic silver rim on top. Both bottles look exactly the same, so there is no way to tell them apart. If I were using this to dispense shampoo and conditioner, I would have trouble knowing which bottle had what solution because the bottles are absolutely identical. I did not see any difference between the two.

Each bottle comes with a clear plastic cap that can be snapped on to prevent the pump from working. In some of my photos the caps are removed as this is the way it should remain during operation. I leave the caps off all the time because I do not want to fiddle with removing them each time I need to wash my hands. In fact the plastic caps are the sturdiest parts of this entire set. In addition, the pump mechanism works very well and feels solid.

The current price of $8.54 ($8.99 minus 5% off) is competitive for this set. Just remember that the bottles are a cheap plastic but when they are in service, it is impossible to tell by looking at them from a distance unless someone squeezes the sides.
